name: cereal-eyes
title: Cereal Eyes
description: Manage Cereal Eyes snippets, shares, and short URLs from Raycast
author: jermashley

commands.name: create-snippet
commands.title: Create Snippet
commands.description: Save a new snippet to Cereal Eyes

commands.name: list-snippets
commands.title: My Snippets
commands.description: Browse and manage your Cereal Eyes snippets

commands.name: url-shortener
commands.title: URL Shortener
commands.description: Create and manage your Cereal Eyes short links

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Your Cereal Eyes API token. Generate one in Settings → API Tokens.

preferences.name: devApiToken
preferences.title: Dev API Token
preferences.description: Used instead of API Token when running in development mode (npm run dev). Leave empty in production.

preferences.name: devApiBaseUrl
preferences.title: Dev API Base URL
preferences.description: Your local Cereal Eyes instance URL. Only active in development mode.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
